input.brief: Funkel Labs, a small bilingual (EN/JA) software studio; Funkel is German for sparkle; the site is a two-ink risograph print

direction.name: Colour chapters
direction.idea: Every section is a chapter with its own flat colour, floor to ceiling. The page reads like a set of posters hung in a row, held together by one typeface and one grid. The colours are not decoration: they come from the subject (the brand's packaging, the artist's record sleeves, the product's own colour ways, the categories of the content) and each chapter's colour means that chapter. Decide the sequence like a designer orders a book: a strong opener, a quiet second, a surprise in the middle, a dark or very light closer.
direction.composition: Sections are full-bleed fields, each at least 90svh tall, butted directly against each other with no gap and no divider. Inside every field the same 12-column grid and the same margins apply, and each field holds one thing: a huge heading (8–12vw) with a small paragraph, or one photograph with a caption, or one list. Text colour is chosen per field for strong contrast (ink or paper, never grey). Headings start on the same left edge in every chapter, so the eye feels the system as colours change. The navigation and the footer take the colours of the first and last chapter.
direction.typography: One typeface in two weights. Headings very large and tight; body 18–20px. Because colour is loud, the type stays plain: no italics, no second face.
direction.colour: Four to six flat fields used at full strength, one per section, each with its assigned text colour. No tints, no gradients between them: the hard edge where two fields meet is the look.
direction.imagery: Sparing. One photograph or object per chapter at most, either cut out and sitting directly on the colour, or a plain rectangle with generous colour around it. Photographs should be simple enough not to fight the field.
direction.richness: Colour at scale. A whole screen of one saturated colour is rich on its own, so a chapter needs few elements; it still needs its content at full size, because a coloured screen with one small line on it reads as empty.
direction.pitfalls: Check contrast on every field with the palette's assigned ink. Do not put cards on the fields. Do not use more than six colours. Two neighbouring fields should differ clearly in lightness as well as hue.

hero.name: Waterline headline
hero.blueprint: Two flat fields fill the viewport and meet at exactly half height: the upper one paper or white, the lower one a saturated palette colour. No image. The headline is two lines of capitals in a black-weight grotesk at clamp(72px, 9vw, 140px), centred, leading 0.86, about 65% of the viewport wide, positioned so the seam cuts through the middle of the second line. Above the seam the letters take the accent ink; below it they switch to a deep ink, as if under water. Build it with two stacked copies of the headline in the same position (the lower copy aria-hidden), each clipped to its own field with clip-path: inset(), or with mix-blend-mode: difference on a single copy if the colours allow. The wordmark sits top-left and the single action, a solid rectangle in the accent ink, top-right, both on 28px margins; there are no other links. Near the bottom, 40px above the edge, one supporting sentence at 20px is centred in the paper colour on the saturated field. Everything else is empty colour.
hero.mobile: The same two fields, meeting at 46% of the height. The headline sets at 15.5vw on two lines, filling the width inside 16px margins, the seam still cutting the second line. The wordmark sits top-left and the action top-right as a small solid rectangle. The supporting sentence sits bottom-left at 17px on the saturated field, on up to three lines.
hero.headline: A blunt statement of 2-4 words in capitals, at most 20 characters, split so each line is one or two words.

motion.name: Masked headline
motion.description: On load, each line of the headline rises from behind its own baseline, about 900ms with a strong ease-out, the second line 110ms after the first; the supporting sentence and the action then fade up together. Nothing else on the page performs. Because headlines are two lines at most, you author the line breaks and wrap each line yourself. Recipe: 'Masked line reveal' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Capabilities at poster scale
sections.blueprint: No images. The heading, two to four words, is the first line of the list itself, set at the same size as the items but in the soft ink, so no separate title sits above. Five to eight capability names follow, one per line, at clamp(40px, 5.2vw, 84px), medium to heavy weight, leading 1.0, tight tracking, flush left on the page margin across columns 1–8 of 12. Each name's one-sentence description is set at 16–18px in columns 9–12, its first baseline aligned with the name's baseline (CSS grid, align-items: first baseline). Rows are separated by 0.35em of space and nothing else. On hover one row keeps full ink while the others fall to 35% opacity. Leave 18–22vh of empty ground above and below; nothing else shares the section.
sections.mobile: Names drop to 11vw and stay one per line; a name that will not fit breaks onto a second line with a hanging indent. Each description sits directly under its name at 16px, indented one margin width, with 28px before the next name. The soft-ink heading line stays as the first row. All rows at full ink.

sections.name: Cards crossing a held photograph
sections.blueprint: A wrapper about 350svh tall holds a sticky stage of 100svh. On the stage one full-bleed photograph of the subject's ground (a landscape, a material, an aerial texture) stays still, darkened evenly with `filter: brightness(0.6)`. Over it a track of four to six cards travels from right to left as the page scrolls (a `translateX` tied to the wrapper's scroll progress), so one card is always near the centre and the next shows about 300px at the right edge. Each card is 720×560px, square corners, vertically centred with 170px of photograph above and below it: its top 68% is a photograph of one item (a room, a building, a stop on the route), its lower 32% a flat panel in one earth tone from the palette, a different tone per card at a similar lightness, holding the item's name at clamp(32px, 3vw, 48px) bottom-left with 28px padding and a two-line description at 16px right-aligned beside it. Cards are 40px apart. The section heading, two to four words at clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 68px) in the paper colour, sits top-left on the stage over the photograph before the first card arrives and moves out ahead of it. Keep the run under three screens; at its end the stage releases into the next section.
sections.mobile: No pin and no sideways travel. The photograph runs full-bleed as a 4:5 band under the heading at 9vw, and the cards follow it at full width minus 16px margins, 24px apart, each a 4:3 photograph over its colour panel 140px tall, with the name at 26px and the description at 16px.

sections.name: Accordion of tinted panels
sections.blueprint: A two-column introduction, then one horizontal accordion. Introduction: the heading, two to four words at clamp(36px, 4vw, 60px), in columns 1–5; one paragraph at 18px in columns 7–11. 64px below, a flex row across columns 1–12, 520px tall, of four to six panels with no gaps. The open stage is a panel taking about 58% of the width; the rest are vertical slivers sharing what remains. Order is carried by colour: the first stage is the darkest tone of one hue and each later stage is a lighter flat tint of it, so the row reads dark to light from left to right. A sliver shows only its stage name, rotated 90 degrees and reading upward, at 20px bold, anchored to its bottom-left. The open panel shows the name at 40px top-left, a 36ch paragraph at 18px bottom-left and, optionally, one photograph in its right half. Clicking a sliver opens it (flex-basis transition, 450ms).
sections.mobile: The accordion turns vertical: stages stack at full width as bars 64px tall in the same dark-to-light order, names set horizontally at 18px. The open stage expands to its content height with the paragraph at 17px. The first stage is open by default.

sections.name: Team on colour tiles
sections.blueprint: A one-line heading of two or three words at 28–36px sits top-left; nothing sits to its right. 40px below, a grid of portrait tiles: six columns with 12px gaps across the full content width for 12 or more people, four columns for 4–8. Every tile is a 4:5 photograph treated identically so mixed-quality headshots look like one set: `filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.15)` with `mix-blend-mode: multiply` over a flat tint, the tints rotating through four palette colours in a fixed order. Square corners or one small radius. Under each tile, left-aligned to its edge with 10px of space: the name at 15px in full ink and the role at 13px in the soft ink, up to two lines. Rows are 36px apart. A leftover tile in the last row stays at the left; it is not centred. No hover lift and no social icons.
sections.mobile: Two columns with 8px gaps; tiles stay 4:5 with names at 14px beneath. For more than ten people, switch to three columns and show the name only. The heading sits above at 24px. Tints keep their rotation, so the grid reads as a checkerboard of colours.

sections.name: Address in display rows
sections.blueprint: The contact block is a stack of five full-width rows, every one set at the same size, clamp(44px, 6vw, 88px), regular weight, left-aligned with a 20px inset and leading 1.0: the building or venue name, the street, the city with postcode, the opening hours as one compact line, the phone number. Each row is about 150px tall with the text sitting in its lower third; rows are told apart by alternating two flat tones of the section colour as full-width bands, or by 28px of space alone. A sixth row holds a one-word greeting at the same size followed, 24px to its right and centred on the x-height, by a solid round button 0.9em across with an arrow, which opens the email or booking link. Street and phone rows are links (map, call). No heading and no form. Optionally, one small round photograph sits at the right end of the first row.
sections.mobile: Rows at 9.6vw with 16px insets, about 84px tall; the hours break onto two rows (days, then times). The greeting row becomes a full-width band in the accent colour with the round arrow button at its right end, 56px across.

sections.name: A footer of tiles
sections.blueprint: The footer is the last two rows of a board: filled tiles with 8px gaps and 8–12px outer margins, every cell used. Upper row, each tile 220px tall: a statement tile in columns 1–4 with one sentence at 24px top-left and the legal text at 12px bottom-left; a navigation tile in columns 5–7 with a plain list at 16px; a tile in columns 8–9 giving the city and local time as text; an email tile in columns 10–12 with the address at 20px as a link, bottom-left. Lower row, 320px tall: a tile in the ink colour spanning columns 1–8 with the wordmark set large (about 9vw) and centred, and a tile in the accent colour in columns 9–12 with a two-to-four-word invitation top-left at 28px and an arrow, drawn as inline SVG with 4px strokes, in its bottom-right corner; the whole accent tile is a link.
sections.mobile: Two columns of tiles with 6px gaps: the wordmark tile full width first at 160px tall, the accent tile full width next, then navigation and email side by side, then time and statement. Every tile keeps 20px padding and top-left text.

references.name: Paul Kalkbrenner
references.idea: Swiss poster typography for a techno artist: the name as one black line with a photo set inside it like a glyph, then every chapter gets its own flat colour and visible grid.
references.hero: Pure white viewport. The artist's name sits on one line at exact vertical centre in bold black neo-grotesk, about 10.4vw, spanning roughly 78% of the width with equal side margins. The space between first and last name is replaced by a small landscape black-and-white photo, x-height tall and resting on the baseline. Top-left is a tiny circular monogram; eight nav links in 13px bold are spread at even intervals across the right half of the top edge. Bottom edge: equaliser bars with a grey label over a track title at left, a three-line bold blurb starting just left of centre, a sound toggle hard right. About 85% is empty.
references.type: ABC Diatype Plus Variable only: bold at -0.05em tracking for display and 13.5px bold for everything functional. Display runs from 150px in the hero to about 44vw elsewhere per the digest. Tiny uppercase labels inside boxed cells; no second face, no italics.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #c5c5c5 #a7ff9c #ff6831 — Black on white to start, then whole sections flood with flat mid-grey, acid mint and orange. Photos inside coloured sections are tinted to the section hue or kept black-and-white.
references.imagery: Portraits and live shots of the artist: full-bleed colour images between sections, a grainy monochrome portrait marked up as a vinyl disc, a green duotone car portrait, and a strip of small mixed-ratio thumbnails. Square corners throughout.
references.layout: Outer margins of only 4-8px; content hangs on a visible column grid with hairlines and boxed cells. Sections alternate between full-bleed photographs and flat colour fields, each arranged differently, so the rhythm is one poster after another.

sections.description: Two words stacked in bold grotesk at roughly 8vw, each preceded by a solid black circle about the height of the lowercase, the second line indented further right than the first. Thin horizontal and vertical hairlines cross the white field at baselines and column edges like a construction grid. Directly beneath is a single row of streaming-service logos spaced evenly edge to edge, then a full-bleed photograph.

Flat mid-grey field split in two. Left half: a square grainy monochrome portrait with a large thin circle drawn on it and a small grey dot at the centre, so the photo reads as a record. Right half: a row of three year tabs and a small link above a hairline, the album title in small bold caps, a short description lower down, and along the bottom two wide outlined cells side by side acting as buttons.

Acid-mint field introducing the tour list. A large photograph, recoloured as a green-and-black duotone, occupies only the top-right quadrant; the left half is left empty. Along the bottom a table header with three tiny uppercase column labels sits on a hairline spanning the full width, where the list of dates begins.

Orange field. A horizontally scrolling strip of small photographs of differing widths runs across the top, cropped by both edges. Below it one outlined rectangle spans the width, divided into three equal cells: two inputs and a submit action, each identified only by tiny centred uppercase text. Small-print lines sit under the left and right cells.

steal: Replace the space between the two words of a giant name with a small photo cropped to x-height.
Flood each chapter with one flat colour and tint its photograph to match as a duotone.
Build forms and button pairs as adjoining outlined cells with tiny uppercase labels instead of filled buttons.
references.media: The hero is almost pure type: the only picture is a 113x75 chip set inside the name, under 1% of the fold, that changes photo every 1-1.5s. Later, full-bleed bands with scrubbed parallax between sections, a square cover in one half beside an info column, a green duotone portrait docked right, a full-bleed photograph that exits through a pixel-block mask, a receding stack of square photos, and an auto marquee of small thumbnails; one YouTube embed, no native video, square corners and an 8s grain overlay.
references.motion: There is no preloader, only the name chip cycling and the equaliser bars bouncing, and Lenis and Barba run 12 ScrollTriggers with no pins: media wrappers parallax by yPercent, a ruled statement drifts sideways, full-bleed photo sections scrub at 0.3 to drive the pixel-block dissolve, and year digits roll like an odometer. Link characters roll over 0.5s with a per-character delay on the house curve cubic-bezier(.625,.05,0,1) (.7s and .35s tokens).

references.name: Warm & Fuzzy
references.idea: A showreel-first studio site in which every section takes one flat, loud colour (blue, black, yellow) under heavy grotesk type and a chunky custom wordmark.
references.hero: The showreel plays full-bleed with a visible film-grain overlay and no scrim. A chunky hand-cut wordmark sits top left, 16px from the edges; the same top line continues with a one-sentence status link, a tiny thumbnail beside the latest project's name, and three caps links at the far right, all white over the footage. A small green caps play label floats at dead centre. The tagline is anchored bottom left, 16px from both edges, in white grotesk caps at 47px (3.3vw) on one line spanning 56% of the width. A tiny square pause control sits bottom right.
references.type: SuisseIntl throughout, rendering heavy, tracked -0.027em: a 47px caps tagline, a caps section title at 9.4vw, statement paragraphs around 5vw with tight leading, and 10 to 11px caps captions. The logo is custom chunky lettering with wobbly cut-paper counters.
references.colour: #000000 #190bb6 #f7dd47 #ffffff #e9479f #1fc27a — Each section is a flat field: ultramarine blue, black, yellow, then blue again. White type on blue and black, black on yellow; a green play label is the only small accent.
references.imagery: Commercial stills and video (candy-coloured CG worlds, product renders, live-action frames) in square-cornered thumbnails of mixed aspect ratios, with a grain layer over the whole page and floating glossy 3D sticker objects.
references.layout: Tight 16px outer margins and edge-to-edge type. Sections are told apart by background colour rather than spacing: a blue statement set in the right two-thirds, a black packed work wall, a yellow full-width paragraph, a blue footer.

sections.description: On black, a tiny caps motto sits top left, then a caps section title at about 9vw flush left with a small underlined link at the far right on its baseline. Beneath, thumbnails pack into an uneven wall: widths vary from one-sixth to one-half of the page, heights differ, gaps are about 8px and rows do not align. Under each image a 10px caps line gives the project name left and the year in grey right.

A yellow field filled edge to edge by one paragraph in black heavy grotesk at roughly 5vw with very tight leading, left-aligned at the 16px margin. Several lines contain deliberate word-sized gaps, as if the text flowed around something, and a small tilted image chip floats over the first lines, covering parts of words.

A full-screen blue field. A top row of tiny caps, email left and three links right, sits above a hairline. A glossy 3D sticker object hangs near the top centre. The chunky wordmark runs the full page width at the bottom in white, about a fifth of the viewport tall, above a bar of tiny caps links divided by vertical hairlines.

steal: Give every section one flat saturated background and change it at each section break, keeping type strictly black or white.
Pack work thumbnails at mixed widths and heights with 8px gaps and a two-part micro caption (name left, year right) under each.
End with the wordmark at full page width on a colour field, with all utility links reduced to a tiny caps bar split by vertical hairlines.
references.media: A 6s muted showreel covers the whole first screen with the nav and title on it and no scrim. Below: an asymmetric top-aligned mosaic of three tile widths (5, 7 and 12 of 24 columns) reshuffled each row with captions under, small inline thumbnails between words of a large paragraph, clips cut into geometric clip-path shapes, a full-bleed photo band with a marquee across its lower edge, and a glossy 3D cube drifting over text and the footer, all at 0px radius under a grain layer that steps every second.
references.motion: A brief ultramarine preloader with a tilted card, then the header and title slide and scale in over 0.5s after a 0.75s delay while the reel carries the motion. Lenis with CSS scroll-driven animations reveals blocks on the scroll timeline, parallaxes figures by 5 to 25svh, translates stacked assets in over 0.75s with a per-item delay and slides a giant sentence left with the scroll, all on one house ease, cubic-bezier(.26,1,.48,1), at 0.5s, with 29 reduced-motion rules.

references.name: Hildén & Kaira
references.idea: The agency name is cast in liquid chrome across the full width, and the same chrome becomes emoji that float through the page, tying a social-media pitch to one material.
references.hero: Warm light-grey field. The lowercase serif wordmark, rendered as polished chrome 3D letters with a molten ampersand, runs edge to edge across the top quarter (about 220px tall, 16px side margins). A tilted portrait video roughly 180 by 220px covers two of its letters. Directly under the wordmark, four small nav links centred. Then 300px of nothing, with one chrome flame emoji floating at the far left. The headline sits in the bottom third: three centred lines of narrow display serif at 4.4vw, leading so tight that descenders touch ascenders, a two-line 15px sans sub, and two square-cornered buttons, black and pale lime.
references.type: PP Editorial New 400 for headlines at 63px, -0.02em tracking and leading near 0.9; PP Neue Montreal 13px for nav, body and buttons. The jump is roughly 5:1 with nothing in between. Stat numerals use the sans at about 60px.
references.colour: #eae9e6 #181818 #ecfdad #b5b5b5 #ffffff #3aa57a — Warm grey and near-black alternate by section. Pale lime is the single accent: secondary buttons, headline text on dark, stat tiles and service cards. Chrome silver recurs as a material.
references.imagery: Chrome 3D-rendered lettering and emoji objects (flame, heart, dove, microphone, wink) floating free; vertical phone videos of client content shown as fanned, slightly rotated stacks with white borders. Square corners throughout.
references.layout: Centred statements with large voids, alternating light and dark full-width bands. Content arrives as square-cornered slabs: a white case card on grey, lime service cards stacking over each other on black. Chrome objects break the grid at the edges.

sections.description: Full-viewport near-black band. A two-line centred serif statement in pale lime at about 4vw sits in the upper third with nothing near it. Two small testimonials are pushed to the bottom-left and bottom-right corners: five tiny stars, two lines of 11px sans, name and title, each centred in its own narrow block. The centre bottom is left empty.

Horizontal carousel of wide white slabs on the grey ground, the next slide peeking at the right edge. Left half: a two-line serif title top-left, then far below a red-dot label over a thin rule and two flat tiles side by side, a wide lime one and a narrower brushed-chrome one, each with a tiny caption and a 60px sans numeral. Right half: a grey panel with three vertical videos fanned like playing cards.

On black, a centred serif section title, then service cards that pin and stack: a lime slab about 55% wide with serif title top-left, grey serif index number top-right, a small paragraph and black button bottom-left and a vertical video inset bottom-right. White and green slabs peek out beneath it, offset downward, and the top card tilts a degree or two as it scrolls.

A full brushed-silver gradient field. The chrome wordmark repeats at full width across the top. Bottom-left, a small serif label over two short link columns; bottom-right, two square translucent tiles each holding a chrome object (microphone, heart) with a serif label above and three tiny square social buttons below. A hairline and a legal row close it.

steal: Render the wordmark in one physical material and reuse that material for small floating objects, so decoration and logo are the same thing.
Leave a third of the hero empty between a top-edge wordmark and a bottom-third headline; the gap makes both read.
Set a display serif with leading under 1.0 so lines interlock, and pair it with 13px sans for everything else.
